STORY_LEVEL_000_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The solitary house rests in the light of sunset. Every stone feels familiar, yet no memory can explain why. A few cardboard boxes wait on the doorstep, as though someone had just arrived—or were about to leave. Then one detail changes, and the stillness begins to feel staged.
STORY_LEVEL_000_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The differences vanish, but the feeling of being watched remains. The memory of picking up the box and carrying it into the bedroom is still fresh. It is a PC—no surprise in reliving a discovery already made.
STORY_LEVEL_001_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The room is neat, just as it would be on any ordinary day: the new computer, the speakers, the light upon the wall. And yet some objects occupy places they have never known. Something feels wrong.
STORY_LEVEL_001_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: Every anomaly set right reveals another, buried deeper. A message appears on the screen: 'Not choosing is a mistake.' The memory is of taking the PC in for repairs.
STORY_LEVEL_002_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The unease follows into the hallway, along with the feeling of being watched. The corridor is different from the one preserved in memory.
STORY_LEVEL_002_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: Fear begins to stir. Among the photographs, the sign of an old electronics shop resurfaces. There was something strange about the mirror. That evening, a journey begins.
STORY_LEVEL_003_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The shop stands closed beneath a soundless sky. Behind the shutters, lifeless appliances can be glimpsed, with cables hanging like veins. Here too, things are not where they belong.
STORY_LEVEL_003_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The displays return to normal for only an instant. The shutter is closed; perhaps someone is inside the shop. But no one comes to open it.
STORY_LEVEL_004_INTRO_TEXT_ID: Old computers crowd every shelf in the shop. Some belong to entirely different eras. Only one monitor is glowing... The chill grows ever more insistent.
STORY_LEVEL_004_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The PC draws the eye. This is an anomaly that demands investigation, as though someone had devised a joke of unspeakably cruel taste.
STORY_LEVEL_005_INTRO_TEXT_ID: This PC belongs to no memory at all. Could it be the key to what is happening?
STORY_LEVEL_005_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: A blinding light erases the shop. The new place awakens a nostalgia too ancient to belong to the present. The passage leads toward a childhood I believed had been forgotten.
STORY_LEVEL_006_INTRO_TEXT_ID: This is the kitchen from the home of a distant childhood. It is as though the memories have sunk deeper still, even as something continues to alter them.
STORY_LEVEL_006_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The objects find their proper places, and with them returns the familiar calm of an ordinary afternoon. No single moment explains why this journey began. The memory moves into the living room.
STORY_LEVEL_007_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The living room is filled with light. Old family photographs are everywhere, but their outlines blur. Some images reveal absences that should not exist.
STORY_LEVEL_007_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The memory of cold winters spent playing video games brings back a feeling of warmth and nostalgia. The journey continues.
STORY_LEVEL_008_INTRO_TEXT_ID: Here, the past can no longer be mistaken for a dream. Every difference alters a piece of childhood, turning tenderness into dread. The presence grows, feeding on the regrets gathered over the years.
STORY_LEVEL_008_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The toys return to their places, and the room recovers its light. It is now certain that this journey runs through a life truly lived, though its purpose remains concealed. Giving it form reveals a scene never witnessed before.
STORY_LEVEL_009_INTRO_TEXT_ID: This place is new. Identical clocks show different hours, while arches repeat with no end in sight. Every moment is preserved within this library of time.
STORY_LEVEL_009_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The clocks stop at the same instant. The sound of an engine replaces their ticking, followed by shattering glass and crushing metal. Beyond the final arch, a road appears. For the first time, the memory offers no comfort: it reveals what happened.
STORY_LEVEL_010_INTRO_TEXT_ID: Two cars lie motionless in the middle of the road, broken by the impact. The landscape is frozen, yet the echo of the crash repeats without end. A figure watches the wreckage without drawing near. No memory surfaces of what came afterward.
STORY_LEVEL_010_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: Something terrible happened in that accident. The collision certainly caused harm, but the true gravity of what occurred cannot be understood. There is a sense that the one responsible was using a smartphone.
STORY_LEVEL_011_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The hospital bed is empty and perfectly made. An IV stand waits beside the mattress, while the open door leads into a silent corridor. Somewhere beyond the walls, familiar voices seem to be calling.
STORY_LEVEL_011_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The voices keep calling from very far away. The accident is more than a memory: the body may still be suspended in that room. Before an answer can come, the hospital light takes on the colors of stained glass. Fear of death transforms the corridor into a church.
STORY_LEVEL_012_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The church is empty, illuminated by a peace that now feels menacing. Every candle is a reminder of how easily a life can be extinguished. There is no funeral, yet every pew suggests an imminent farewell. The omen is strong enough to awaken a single desire: escape.
STORY_LEVEL_012_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The doors open, but they do not lead outside. Behind the altar, a path emerges among cypresses and weathered stones. The presence does not prevent escape; it lets fear choose the way. The path ends before the gates of a cemetery.
STORY_LEVEL_013_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The cemetery looms over the valley, its gates flung wide. No headstone bears a legible name, yet each seems poised to reveal one at any moment. The church may have been a warning; this place feels like a destination.
STORY_LEVEL_013_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: Among the graves, there is no proof that death has already occurred. A chance still remains, and for that very reason, fear turns fiercer. The landscape darkens, the walls close in, and every exit disappears. The flight ends in a room suspended between the world and nothingness.
STORY_LEVEL_014_INTRO_TEXT_ID: A lantern illuminates a room that belongs neither to the house nor to the hospital. The mirror is black and returns no reflection. Here, regrets assume the shape of the presence that has tainted every memory. They were not pursuing the body; they were keeping the mind from choosing.
STORY_LEVEL_014_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The presence begins to unravel once it is finally recognized. There is no single guilt to atone for, only an imperfect life and too many possibilities left behind. The mirror opens like a surface of violet water. Beyond limbo waits a world where the choice can still be made.
STORY_LEVEL_015_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The portal drags with it objects, places, and fragments from every age. The entire life traversed thus far spirals toward a single center. What meaning lies within all that has been lived?
STORY_LEVEL_015_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: At the heart of the vortex, all sound dies away. A warm light sketches a house beside the water, far from the accident and the fear. It is the place memory would have wished to build. The astral world offers first a dream, then the truth.
STORY_LEVEL_016_INTRO_TEXT_ID: The dream house rests beside a clear river. It holds no mistakes, no regrets, no hospital rooms—only the promise of a simple, happy life. For that very reason, it cannot be a memory. It is what might have been, and what might still be longed for.
STORY_LEVEL_016_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The dream's perfection begins to dissolve without becoming a nightmare. No real life can remain motionless in that light, and no choice can be made while hiding here. The path reaches an ancient bridge suspended between earth and stars. Both possibilities wait on the other side.
STORY_LEVEL_017_INTRO_TEXT_ID: Half the bridge still belongs to the familiar landscape; the other half vanishes among clouds and stars. Every step leads farther from the dream and closer to the decision. To return means accepting pain, consequences, and uncertainty. To go on means leaving everything behind, without knowing what new form may arise.
STORY_LEVEL_017_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The bridge does not decide for those who cross it. Before its end, one final memory appears, guarded not by regret but by affection. Friendly faces, days spent together, and bonds the accident could not erase. The choice must also reckon with those who are still waiting.
STORY_LEVEL_018_INTRO_TEXT_ID: A photograph gathers friends, smiles, and roads traveled together. For the first time, the differences do not seek to distort the memory, but to reveal how incomplete it was. Life was not made solely of missed chances. There were people who were loved—and perhaps theirs are the voices heard in the hospital.
STORY_LEVEL_018_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The guilt does not vanish, but it ceases to be the only voice. What remains is the love received, the love not yet returned, and the longing to see those who stayed beside the bed. The photograph divides into two opposing lights. The astral world opens its final doors.
STORY_LEVEL_019_INTRO_TEXT_ID: Two thresholds wait in the darkness. The illuminated door leads toward the wounded body, the consequences of the accident, and the people still calling. The dark portal leads beyond that life, toward a possibility without memories or certainties. No presence gives chase anymore: for the first time, the choice is free.
STORY_LEVEL_019_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: Before the two thresholds, fear and hope carry equal weight. There is no path without loss, and no promise can reveal what lies beyond. Only the freedom to give one final meaning to the life remembered remains. At last, the decision can be made.
STORY_LEVEL_019_LIFE_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The illuminated door opens onto the voices in the hospital. There is no knowing which wounds will remain, or how difficult it will be to begin again. But there are people worth loving, and a life still worth fighting for. The first breath hurts; that is precisely why it is real.
STORY_LEVEL_019_DEATH_OUTRO_TEXT_ID: The portal receives every memory without erasing its worth. If everything that happened is real, then so too may be the chance to begin again in a new life. Those left behind are given a farewell filled with love, not a plea to forget. Then the past fades away, and something new opens its eyes.
